title: The app's loopback receiver and browser launch for an external sign-in
spec: Loopback::bind listens on 127.0.0.1 on a system-chosen port; redirect_uri is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback. wait(state, deadline) takes one acceptable redirect: GET /callback with a state equal to the expected one (constant-time), returning its percent-decoded code (printable ASCII, at most 2048 bytes) or, with error=..., Provider(error); every other request (another path or method, a wrong or missing state, no code, over 8 KiB) is answered (404 or 400) and ignored; nothing acceptable before the deadline is TimedOut. Answers are a short no-store HTML page with a strict CSP. Code's Debug hides the code. parse_query decodes %XX and + and drops undecodable pairs. open_browser opens only https URLs without spaces, passing the URL as one argument to the platform opener (rundll32 url.dll on Windows, open on macOS, xdg-open elsewhere), never through a shell.
